title: Allah Opens Mercy and Sends Life to the Earth

paragraphs.text: If you could see the disbelievers when they are terrified on that Day, you would see that they have no escape. They will suddenly say that they believe, but it will be too late, because they rejected the truth before and spoke about the unseen without knowledge. A barrier will be placed between them and what they wish for, just as happened with people like them in the past.

All praise belongs to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, who made angels as messengers with two, three or four wings. When Allah opens His mercy to people, no one can stop it, and when He holds it back, no one can release it. People are reminded of His favors, because there is no other creator who provides for them. If the Prophet is denied, earlier messengers were denied too. The promise of Allah is true, so people should not be fooled by worldly life or by the Deceiver. Satan is an enemy, so he must be treated as an enemy. He only calls his followers to the Fire.

Allah sends the winds, which move the clouds, and He brings dead land back to life with rain; this is how the dead will be raised. All honor belongs to Allah, and good words rise up to Him. He created people from dust, then from a drop, and made them in pairs. No woman becomes pregnant or gives birth without His knowledge, and every lifespan is written in a record. From both fresh and salty water people eat tender meat and take ornaments, and ships sail through them. Allah makes the night enter the day and controls the sun and moon, while false gods own nothing, not even the thin skin of a date seed.
